task.title: To insert fields in a template as a section

step.cmd: Open a template in X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab and click Fields.
Place the cursor in the section of the template text where you want to insert a section and click Insert Field. This open the Insert Fields dialog box.
Select an Object (i.e., "Agreement") from the left column. To search a field related to the selected object in the right column, enter a keyword and click the Search icon () or press enter.
Select the required fields. To select multiple fields, hold Ctrl (keyboard key) and select the fields.

note.p: Fields are inserted one below the other based on the order you select. Do not move your cursor when the fields are being inserted.

step.cmd: Select the Insert as a Section radio button.
Click Insert. A repeat section is inserted into your template with each field displayed one below the other.

ol.li: Navigate to the Fields tab. This displays the Repeat Section (object name) and the fields in the repeat section.
Enter the field name in the search field and click the search icon().

step.cmd: To make an inserted field smart field or read-only:

ol.li: Click the Settings icon () adjacent to the selected field name to open the Settings page.
In the Filed Settings pane, toggle the Smart Field or Read-Only Field switch based on your requirement and click Save.

postreq.p: A repeat section is inserted into your template with each field displayed one below the other.
